note: Premier Bank's Personal Current Account page, read on 2026-11-03: the account lets its holder keep money 'while paying only for the transactions you make', so it carries no fee to keep. Its charges and limits are in US dollars, as Somalia's banks keep accounts, so the account is written in dollars. Its applicable charges are a cheque book (10 dollars) and processing an ATM card (10 dollars), each paid once on request, which the account's form has no term for, so they aren't written; its ATM withdrawals are limited to 1,000 dollars a day. Opening asks an identity card or passport, proof of residence and proof of income, which the game doesn't check. Dahabshil, Salaam, Amal and IBS Bank publish no fees (earlier rounds).

sources.said: Our Personal Current Account allows you to keep your money safe while paying only for the transactions you make, at really affordable rates Key Features & Benefits: Free monthly statement Access to international payments – telegraphic transfers (inward and outward) Free internal standing orders Free internet banking 50 leaf Cheque book ATM card ATM withdrawal up to USD 1,000 daily SMS notifications Requirements: 2 Colored passport size photographs Certified copies of valid ID or passport Proof of residence – P.O Box Number or Physical Address ... Applicable Charges Cheque book – USD 10 ATM card processing – USD 10
